about: Where points fall in the reference photos (references.json, dvids*), in pixels of the full-size image, read off by eye at full resolution, and which points' coordinates the sources cite. verify/photos.py solves every photo's camera and every marked point together from these: points are [station, waterline, buttline] in inches, null where no source gives the coordinate, with the uncertainty in inches. Points a photo marks that are not listed here are measured, never cited. Pairs ending _left and _right are solved as one point and its mirror image. Each photo's pose drives the model as the jet stood (gear down, surfaces as the photo shows them) for its outline and curves. A pose's "joints" sets single surfaces in radians past their drives: each is verify/poses.py's fit of that surface to the photo's own outline against the sky (2026-11-01, on the build with the flap ending at BL 153), kept where it halves a miss of 0.7 in or more, lies within tp209033's travel limits (facts surfaces.limits) and agrees with its pair: the rudders toed in on the take-off series, the stabilators about 10 deg trailing edge up on the ground, the flaps and ailerons a few degrees off in flight. navy090707N7665E003 takes none: its camera, through a window, cannot be trusted aft of the nose. Every point is measured, cited and reported with the gear down and every surface neutral ("pose"): the cited axles are the gear-down wheel centres, and a mark on a part a photo poses otherwise is carried into that photo's pose.

dvids7418477.notes: Wide-angle, close camera roughly abeam the nose gear: far-side features shift strongly forward (right fin tip ~950 px forward of the left one, right main wheel ~1000 px). Nose tip and left fin trailing corner are outside the frame. bow_top is the top of the fixed windscreen's aft arch (canopy raised); it sits on a flat top, so +-10 px along x. lex_fence_* are the top corners of the left LEX fence (also marked in dvids9820782 and dvids8678629). Not marked: the LEX leading edge (two parallel boundaries, a thin dark line and a lit band's lower edge, and I could not tell for certain which is the edge; the fence's base being cut off along the upper line suggests the camera is below the LEX and the upper line is the edge); right main axle (wheel seen from its inboard side, brake hardware in front of the hub); nose wheels (near hub hidden by the standing person); inlet lip; gun port and radome joint (the gun fairing is a long slot with no clear centre). Control-surface deflections not assessed. windscreen_top (2026-11-01) was marked as bow_top: with the canopy raised the mark is the fixed windscreen's aft arch, not the bow, which rose with the canopy; carried with the canopy's pose it missed by 70 in. dvids9820782.notes: Camera is above the LEX plane: the LEX top surface shows as a lit band and lex_edge_left is its lower (outer) boundary against the shadow beneath. Takeoff configuration: leading-edge flaps, trailing-edge flaps and ailerons drooped well down (the drooped flap and aileron undersides hang visibly below the wing), so no wingtip or fold marks and no lex_wing_left (the drooped LEF's root splits the kink). canopy_sill_left is the dark canopy-to-fuselage seam from just aft of the bow to sill_aft_left; it carries no snap because it is a thin line, and the points are on its centre. lex_fence_* are the top corners of the left LEX fence (also marked in the other two shelter/profile photos). Not marked: bow_foot_left (frame foot vs canopy corner differ by ~30 px), canopy_crown/canopy_aft (flat top, seam meets the outline unclearly), gun port, radome joint, inlet lip, right nose axle (hub behind the strut). windscreen_base is not marked: from above, the frame's side corner is not the centreline point.

dvids9820749.notes: This is a left-REAR quarter near profile, not front: both nozzle exits face the camera, the near (left) fin sits forward of the far one in the image and the far main wheel appears aft of the near one. Fin tip trailing marks are the fins' own corners above the antenna fairings. windscreen_base is where the white-reflecting windscreen meets the dark nose silhouette (+-5 px). dvids8678629.notes: Close wide-angle camera. lex_edge_left is the single sharp lit-to-shadow boundary under the LEX, which is the outer edge whichever side of the LEX plane the camera is on. apex is the leftmost point of the small radome tip cap. axle_nose_left is the centre of the near (left) nose wheel's rim and hub cavity; the protruding axle cap sits ~15 px to the right of it. spine is the upper-fuselage silhouette aft of the open canopy against the bright shelter opening; it stops before the LEX fence. The leading-edge flap looks drooped (its inboard end stands proud at the LEX-wing junction), so no lex_wing_left. Not marked: windscreen_base and bow_top (view too oblique to place the centreline points), left fin trailing corner (rounded, antenna fairing on it), inlet lip (the visible dark seam may be a joint behind the actual lip edge), main axle (wheel seen nearly edge-on), wingtip (out of frame). CANOPY (2026-11-02): open 30.4 deg, fitted by verify/poses.py against the sky (2.54 in over 135 places at the model's full 45 deg, 0.56 over 113); dvids8678631, the same jet in the same shelter, fits 30.8. dvids9820791.notes: Not orthographic: the jet is seen from slightly to its LEFT (about 10-12 deg of yaw): the nose apex sits ~150 px photo-right of the wingtips' midpoint and the fins are shifted photo-left. Arresting cable stretched across the runway in front of the jet. Wingtips NOT marked: each tip carries a rail with a pod/missile (rounded nose and fins, see the ACMI-type pod on the right tip in dvids9820799); the wing's own tip corners cannot be separated from the rail here. Wing edges stop ~20 px inboard of the rails. Inlet lips NOT marked: both inlets are in deep shadow; the right lip is a faint grey ring with no contrasting outer boundary (top ~y1580 at x~3255, unreliable), the left inlet is mostly hidden behind the radome. Fin tips NOT marked: each fin tip is seen nearly end-on (~12 px wide), leading and trailing corners cannot be told apart (topmost points: right fin ~(3099,1317), left fin ~(3425,1318)). Apex NOT marked: the radome tip faces the camera and shows no point (light highlight disc centred ~(3466,1617), +-6 px). bow_top is the apex of the white windscreen arch (parabola fit of its top edge, x +-2); the transparent canopy behind it rises higher but its outline is invisible, so no canopy outline edge is given. Wheels are seen tread-on; axle points are the centres of each tyre's silhouette bounding box (top to ground contact), +-3 px; the left main tyre's top at y~1693 vs right main ~1697. The inner wing panels look thicker than the outer panels: a step in both the upper and lower right-wing outline at the fold line (x~2930), consistent with leading/trailing-edge flaps drooped on the inner panel (or the fold joint fairing); the edges are split there. Wing upper edges are white leading-edge/upper surface against dark trees; lower edges are the shadowed underside against trees. The wheel marks are the centres of each tyre's silhouette (wheel_*), not hub faces (axle_*). Left out of the solve: five marks cannot fix its camera (the wingtips, inlets, fin tips and apex cannot be placed in it).

dvids9820799.notes: Near (right) fin is the one at photo-left (x 3800-4400); the far (left) fin rises behind the canopy (x 5400-5650). Forward is photo-right. Right wingtip carries a pod on its rail (rounded nose with a small probe below, extending ahead of the LE and behind the TE). wingtip_trailing_right / wingtip_leading_right are where the wing's trailing / leading edge meets that pod, i.e. the wing's own corners as seen against the rail (+-3 px; leading corner is the end of the shadowed LE line). In this view the wing's leading edge is the LOWER edge of the white wing band (pylons hang from it) and the trailing edge is the upper one; wing_right_trailing is that upper edge against trees. sill_aft_right: where the dark canopy-sill gap line ends; the canopy's aft edge rising from it is faint (+-3 px, least sure of this one). The right nose axle is the visible hub centre of the obliquely seen wheel (+-4 px). The left one, marked at first on the far wheel's inboard face, is dropped (2026-11-01): marking.md marks a hub only where its outboard face shows. Right main axle not marked: wheel nearly edge-on, hub ambiguous by ~10 px. Apex NOT marked: the radome tip is seen obliquely as a rounded glossy blob (~(7082,2529)); its forward-most point is ambiguous by ~10 px. Gun port / radome joint / windscreen base NOT marked (not resolvable to a few px at this angle). light_strip_aft_corner = top-aft corner of the aft-most of the three formation-light strips under the '04'; light_strip_forward_corner = bottom-forward corner of the forward-most strip (same points marked in dvids9820810 and dvids9820801). Canopy edge is the canopy glass outline aft of the crown only. Stabilators hidden behind pylons/stores. Arresting cable lies on the runway in front.

dvids9820810.notes: Close shot, strong perspective (the nose is relatively larger than in dvids9820801). Canopy closed, pilot aboard. The gun muzzle slot is cut into the top of the nose at the radome joint: the circumferential seam runs down the side from the slot's aft lower corner, and meets the top silhouette at the slot's aft tip, so radome_top = slot aft tip and gun_port = centroid of the slot opening (slot runs ~4549-4632 px), i.e. the port is just ahead of the joint as the brief says. Probe door = long panel on the upper right nose ahead of the windscreen; its lower edge runs from probe_door_aft to probe_door_front. canopy_aft = where the canopy's aft edge line (which comes down to sill_aft_right) meets the top silhouette, ~70 px aft of where the glass ends (+-4 px, least sure). Canopy outline is the thin dark top line of the transparent glass (no snap). Sill edge is the centre of the dark canopy/fuselage gap line (no snap). axle_nose_right = centre of the near nose wheel hub rings. The left nose wheel hub is hidden behind the strut; inlet not visible (below LEX, behind stores). nose_bottom stops at x 4600: a fairing under the nose at ~4300-4450.

dvids9820801.notes: Firefighters in the foreground hide the tail cone, nozzles, hook, stabilator and nose gear; nothing marked near them. Below y~1230 the sky-facing edge right of the near fin is the FAR (left) fin's leading edge (offset ~55 px right of the near fin's LE line); the near fin's LE is only against sky above y~1215. fin_tip_leading_left is the far fin's top-forward corner peeking above; its trailing corner is hidden. fin_tip_leading_right is on the rounded tip corner (intersection of the top-edge and LE lines is ~2 px outside it, at (2879,1037)). fin_right_trailing includes the rudder's trailing edge (rudder looks neutral). apex +-4 px: the radome's lower side is in shadow against dark trees. radome_top / gun_port: same construction as dvids9820810 (slot aft tip on the silhouette; centroid of the slot opening). Canopy outline = thin glass edge against sky (no snap), skipping the bow at x~6400 where the frame sits a few px below the glass line. canopy_aft +-4 px (where the canopy aft edge line leaves the top silhouette). light_strip_* = the formation-light strip corners also marked in dvids9820810 and dvids9820799.

dvids9820748.notes: Camera ahead of the jet's left side, roughly 35-40 deg off the nose, above the LEX (its top surface shows) and below the canopy top. Photo-right = aft and aircraft-left; the photo-right fin is the left fin. DEFLECTIONS: leading-edge flaps drooped, roughly 10-20 deg by eye (the LEF's inboard end stands below the LEX edge at the junction, x 4715-4915); trailing-edge flaps and ailerons drooped well down, roughly 30-40 deg (their lower surfaces hang as a dark band below the wing, the aileron's outboard edge a diagonal from about 6952,3172 to 7015,3275); the left stabilator's outboard tip shows past the wingtip (white, x 6955-7305, y 3115-3220) with its tip edge rising steeply to the trailing corner, consistent with trailing-edge-up roughly 5-12 deg as in dvids9820756; rudders not judged. Hook down (not marked); canopy closed. INLET: the lip is a bright rim round the outboard side of a dark mouth; its inboard ends meet the splitter plate's outboard face, which runs on aft as the duct's inboard wall (perforated/streaked band x 4440-4530 ahead of the mouth). inlet_lip_top/bottom/outer are on the rim's outer boundary (top boundary against the shadow under the LEX, bottom boundary against the shadow below, outboard boundary against the inlet's outer face); the inlet_lip_left edge is the centre of the rim highlight (the leading edge), with no snap because the rim is 10-15 px wide and either of its boundaries could capture a snap. splitter_left is the plate's leading edge from where it meets the LEX underside (splitter_top_left) to its rounded lower-front corner (splitter_bottom_left). LEAST CERTAIN: inlet_corner_bottom_left (+-6 px along the outline: the lip's lower curve fairs smoothly into the plate's lower edge, read where the rim highlight ends and the outline leaves the plate's straight lower edge; it sits about 50 px left of the top corner, so the inboard wall leans or the lower lip is filleted forward); inlet_lip_top_left (rim top is nearly flat from x 4555 to 4600, so +-15 px along it, +-2 px in height); inlet_lip_outer_left (rim is near vertical from y 3305 to 3345, so +-15 px in height, +-2 px across); bow_top (+-15 px along the flat top of the bow arch, seen through the glass below the canopy silhouette); canopy_crown (+-25 px along a flat top); canopy_aft (+-5 px, low contrast); axle_nose_left (+-4 px). The canopy and windscreen outline edges are glass against sky with weak contrast, so no snap; the windscreen and canopy edges stop short of the bow (x 2990-3140), where the bow frame and glass outlines cross. nose_top skips x 2230-2430, where the gun muzzle fairing sits on the silhouette. fin_leading_left stops at y 2800 (lower down the right fin's trailing edge meets it); fin_leading_right stops at y 2750 above the spine. SKIPPED: wingtip corners (the trailing corner is on the drooped aileron, the leading corner hidden by the tip rail and AIM-9); stabilator tip corners (leading corner hidden behind the drooped aileron, trailing corner rounded); lex_wing_left (drooped LEF splits the kink); nozzles (hidden behind the drooped flaps); the far (right) main wheel and the right nose wheel show their inboard faces, so no axle marks for them; gun_port and radome_top (the muzzle fairing is seen obliquely from below and the radome seam does not reach the silhouette visibly); sill_aft_left (no clear corner); hook_point (hook down). The axle marks are left out: the jet is decelerating in the arresting wire, its struts compressed, a pose the model does not take (they missed by 2-5 in while the rest fit within 1.5 in). HOOK (2026-10-31): the hook is down and on the arresting cable; the shoe's tip at [6243, 3700] is cast onto the centreline (cast.py), not marked: the two photos catch the hook at different moments, so it is no single point, and a mark would pull the camera, where the dark shank meets the arresting cable (+-8 px). The pivot is hidden.

dvids8678631.notes: Left side from about 20 degrees off the nose axis (the main tyre is near tread-on, the nose-wheel hub rim is a 31 x 98 px ellipse), camera at about the lower inlet lip's height (horizon near y 2820). The inlet is in deep shade; read with level stretches. INLET: the D's flat side is the photo-left of the mouth, the splitter the lit crescent left of it. inlet_lip_outer_left is the rightmost point of the lip's front highlight; x is good to 2 px, but the lip is vertical from y 2720 to 2750, so y is good only to about 8 px. inlet_lip_bottom_left is the lower lip's outer limb (its lowest silhouette), the vertex of a flat curve: y good to 2 px, x to about 5 px. inlet_corner_top_left is where the top rim's highlight ends against the splitter's face (rim at y 2652-2655, ends at x 4436-4440), good to about 4 px. Left out: inlet_lip_top_left, because the top rim is flat to within 2 px from the corner to x 4492 (y 2651 outer side, 2653 highlight), so no highest point can be placed in x; and inlet_corner_bottom_left, because the lower lip curves up leftward into the lit lower end of the splitter around x 4395-4410, y 2840-2850 with no crisp corner (a fitting sits at 4385-4395, 2835-2865). The inlet_lip_left trace runs along the lip's front highlight with no snap, since the strongest gradient is the dark duct boundary 3-5 px inside it; it stops at x 4425, short of the bottom corner. The splitter leading edge is clearly curved (a crescent), not straight. splitter_top_left is where the plate's leading edge meets the LEX underside (the top of the dark boundary-layer gap behind it), +-3 px in y. The right inlet is hidden by the nose, the nose gear and the centreline tank.
